name: Zaizenji Kirino
source:
School principal. Her family has been in charge of this school for generations.
Recently lost her husband, and is getting thanks to her mother's assistance.
She used to be very calm and collected, but the busy and hectic lifestyle has been taking a toll on her. As a result, she can be overly harsh on students with bad behavior.
